pairs: And as he was departing from the temple,
ait illi unus ex discipulis suis:
one of his disciples said to him,
“Do you see all these great buildings?
There shall not be left stone upon stone,
Et cum sederet in monte Olivarum contra templum,
And as he sat at the Mount of Olives,
opposite the temple, Peter, and James,
“Tell us, when will these things be,
et quod signum erit, quando hæc omnia incipient consummari?
and what will be the sign when all these things will begin to be fulfilled?”
Et respondens Jesus cœpit dicere illis:
And Jesus, answering, began to say to them:
“See to it that no one leads you astray.
multi enim venient in nomine meo,
For many will come in my name, saying,
dicentes quia ego sum: et multos seducent.
‘For I am he,’ and they will lead many astray.
But when you will have heard of wars
but the end is not so soon.
For nation will rise up against nation,
and there shall be earthquakes in various places,
These are but the beginning of the sorrows.
For they will hand you over to councils,
and in the synagogues you will be beaten,
et ante præsides et reges stabitis propter me,
and you shall stand before governors and kings because of me,
Et in omnes gentes primum oportet prædicari Evangelium.
And the Gospel must first be preached to all nations.
And when they have seized you and handed you over,
do not consider in advance what to say.
sed quod datum vobis fuerit in illa hora,
But whatever will be given you in that hour,
For you will not be speaking,
Tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem,
Then brother will betray brother to death,
and children will rise up against their parents and will bring about their death.
Et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum.
And you will be hated by all for the sake of my name.
But whoever will have persevered unto the end,
Cum autem videritis abominationem desolationis stantem,
Then, when you have seen the abomination of desolation,
standing where it ought not to be,
tunc qui in Judæa sunt, fugiant in montes:
then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
et qui super tectum, ne descendat in domum,
And let whoever is on the rooftop not descend to the house,
nec introëat ut tollat quid de domo sua:
nor enter so as to take anything from the house.
et qui in agro erit, non revertatur retro tollere vestimentum suum.
And let whoever may be in the field not return to take his garment.
Væ autem prægnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus.
But woe to those who are pregnant or nursing in those days.
Orate vero ut hieme non fiant.
Truly, pray that these things may not happen in winter.
Erunt enim dies illi tribulationes tales quales non fuerunt ab initio creaturæ,
For those days shall have such tribulations as have not been since the beginning of the creation that God founded,
And unless the Lord had shortened the days,
no flesh would be saved. But,
for the sake of the elect,
Et tunc si quis vobis dixerit:
And then, if anyone will have said to you:
For false Christs and false prophets will rise up,
et dabunt signa et portenta ad seducendos,
and they will present signs and wonders, so as to lead astray,
Behold, I have foretold all to you.
et luna non dabit splendorem suum:
and the moon will not give her splendor.
And the stars of heaven will be falling down,
et virtutes, quæ in cælis sunt, movebuntur.
and the powers that are in heaven will be moved.
Et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus cum virtute multa
And then they shall see the Son of man arriving on the clouds,
And then he will send his Angels,
et congregabit electos suos a quatuor ventis,
and gather together his elect, from the four winds,
a summo terræ usque ad summum cæli.
from the limits of the earth, to the limits of heaven.
Now from the fig tree discern a parable.
Cum jam ramus ejus tener fuerit,
and the foliage has been formed,
cognoscitis quia in proximo sit æstas:
you know that summer is very near.
et vos cum videritis hæc fieri,
when you will have seen these things happen,
know that it is very near,
that this lineage shall not pass away,
until all these things have happened.
Heaven and earth shall pass away,
but my word shall not pass away.
But concerning that day or hour,
For you do not know when the time may be.
Sicut homo qui peregre profectus reliquit domum suam,
It is like a man who, setting out on a sojourn, left behind his house,
et dedit servis suis potestatem cujusque operis,
and gave his servants authority over every work,
and instructed the doorkeeper to stand watch.
vigilate ergo (nescitis enim quando dominus domus veniat:
Therefore, be vigilant, for you do not know when the lord of the house may arrive:
in the evening, or in the middle of the night,
or at first light, or in the morning.
when he will have arrived unexpectedly,
